# git-defaults-preview

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The git-defaults preview, for developers: a switch in the action bar's view-options popover makes this tab read every config from the committed layer (what a brand-new user sees) instead of the user's own, read-only, and an action-bar mark shows while it is on (click to exit; it toasts a refused write).
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `ActionBar.ViewOption` → `GitDefaultsPreviewSwitch`
    - `ActionBar.Item` → `PreviewIndicator`
  - Uses:
    - `audience.useAudience`
    - `audience/developer-mark.DeveloperMark`
    - `config_v2.onConfigWriteRefused`
    - `config_v2.setConfigPreview`
    - `config_v2.useConfigPreview`
    - `primitives/css/control-panel.ControlPanel`
    - `primitives/icon-button.IconButton`
    - `primitives/loading.Loading`
    - `shell/action-bar.ActionBar`
    - `shell/toast.showToast`
    - `ui/icons.Icon`
